replies.body:
This is to Koja and others that mentioned the size, to start of we where following and editing the layout of a old map we both remembered, the old map was a small CTF, i do not know how to enplane it but there was a under ground bit and a  gap spawner at mid, you would place the flag above your spawn and capture it just in front, we noticed how much people enjoyed this map and it basically was the map that started people of with XP, we wanted to do that, we wanted a small CTF with hopefully the same vibes to capture the eye's of the public, i agree more detail is needed we will try our best to fix that "The buildings have no uniqueness either" what?.

The grass was just so we could show it easier in the pictures this will have some gravel and other blocks.

There's my pitch and also we will add a lot more so don't completely shred our build up and think about the good stuff and what more it needs rather then just instant -1's. 

Thank You!

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
Team colors being black and white are not allowed, you'll need to pick something else.

The map is extremely bland, being that the ground uses only one block and has very limited height variation. It looks very boring and there needs to be way more cover. The lanes are way too condensed compared to the rest of the map and it is very aesthetically bad. You mixed stone brick, spruce, jungle and spruce leaves, cobble, and glowstone as the only build elements to the map, in which cobble and glowstone alone are the ugliest blocks in the game, not including the random iron ore in the ground.

To make this map salvageable, you'll need trenches, more height variation, to expand it (it's wayyyy too small for any rotation whatsoever, it's a 6v6.) And you'll need to make it look presentable, because even Salvo has better aesthetics. Seeing as the images are at night, you'll need WAY more light (and natural lighting at that) to make it not so dark on the playing field.

The flag is also not shown in the screenshots. Is it in the middle? And you should always take screenshots in default FOV and fullscreen mode, so we can zoom in to the shots.The map then it's too open for the flag to be really (anywhere) because there's literally nothing preventing any form of navigation around the terrain, going back to the map being too open. Once someone would get the flag, then you can run straight back without any obstacles whatsoever.

Also, what are the enchantments of the sword in the middle? Is it a one hit kill sword, or what?

Updates:
1. Team colours changed to Lime and Pink
